method: the DSpark 8K record's composition (results/rtl/qwen_dspark_system_20261004/ctx8k/step_composed_ctx8k.json: verify = 36 x verify layer L0 step 1 + verify head p4; step = verify + draft + commit; per-user = tau x clock / step) with the verify layer re-measured on the 4-stack full-bandwidth KV path
tau_source: results/speculative/third_party_acceptance_20261004/acceptance.json models.qwen3_8b.by_draft_tokens.3 (DERIVED from published DSpark Table 1 (Qwen3-8B, gamma 7, T=1.0): per benchmark solve constant conditional acceptance r from tau7 = 1 + sum_{i<=7} r^i, then tau3 = 1 + sum_{i<=3} r^i; equal weight over the 9 benchmarks (3 math, 3 code, 3 chat))
unvalidated: draft cycles (drafter layers measured on REAL_MEM tagged fill; drafter ingest/Markov priced, as in the record)
verify head and E/head from P255/record (position independent)
verify layer not prefetched (isolated); a chained verify with early_go would hide <= its 1,362-cycle fill
verdict: on the full-bandwidth KV path the 8K verify layer is compute bound (17,197 vs 6,489 plain): the DSpark step per user is below AR with prefetch even with a free draft

all_reduces.note: 4x payload on the same link: inherent to the collective bandwidth

attention_kv_passes.lever: share each K/V pass between block positions: the scores/PV ME op already serves a GQA group of 4 query heads per K word (me_jsh); 2 positions per pass = 8 queries (jsh 3 = IL) halves the passes (-2,322 a layer), program + golden change; causality: the extra key of the earlier position must be masked to an exact zero weight
attention_kv_passes.verify: 4 x ~1,161 (QK/PV over 8K keys, one pass a position)

levers_ranked: SU ops without a DYN term merged across positions (region-major VM layout so p copies are one op with nout x p): latency paid once
single weight pass for the block (needs p accumulators a lane, i.e. 4x MACs, or no gain: the ROM read rate equals the MAC rate)
verify_op_breakdown.remaining_composition: per-position stream-unit ops issued back to back (latency-bound: e.g. 8x64 ops take 30-42 cycles for 8 cycles of work) and the weight matvecs re-streamed once a position (qkv 4x152, gu 278+3x152, down 4x118, o 4x~40)
verify_op_breakdown.source: RT_OPTRACE instruction-fetch trace, die 0, P8187, STREAM4 (dspark_verify_P8187/optrace): verify np4 17,197 vs AR np1 6,479 (both exact)

verify_segment_breakdown.non_weight_excess: the larger excess is non-ME per-position work: 17,197 - 6,489 - 2,144 = 8,564 cycles a layer (vector/SFU ops x4, all-reduce payload x4, write-bridge stalls 3,153 vs 425)
verify_segment_breakdown.source: per-cycle sequencer trace (RT_PROGRESS=1): verify S1L0 on STREAM4 (dspark_verify_P8187/s1_trace, exact) vs AR L0 isolated P8191 (runtime_P8191/L0_iso_p16)
verify_segment_breakdown.weight_reuse_finding: the weight engines are busy 1.47x (attention block) and 2.09x (MLP) of AR for 4 positions: weight words are NOT applied to all 4 positions in one pass (full reuse would keep ME-busy ~1.0x). Lever = one weight pass for the block: measured bound 2,144 ME-busy cycles a layer (1,048 attention + 1,096 MLP) = 77k cycles a token (9.6% of the verify step)
